title: Secret Lair Drop Series: A Perfectly Normal Superdrop

paragraphs.text: A Perfectly Normal Superdrop is a superdrop in the Secret Lair product range and a continuation of the alternate art Secret Lair Drop Series . It became available for purchase from the Wizards of the Coast webshop secretlair.wizards.com on August 31, 2026.
This superdrop is a mixed bag of eight Secret Lairs, including four Marvel drops, two other Universes Beyond drops, and a drop in the Artist Series . Four of the drops focus on specific artists.
For every $199 spent in a single order, you can get a borderless Secret Lair Promo Command Tower with art by Leon Tukker . It depicts the Avengers Tower .

As an extra, the drops come with a surprise bonus card . For some drops, the exact card issued is random and could include retro frame humans (e.g. Darien, King of Kjeldor or Glowrider ). The fixed bonus cards for the other drops are listed below.
